mapper.select: SELECT r.receipt_no, r.doc_type, r.partner_name, r.total_amount, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date FROM order_receipt r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM order_receipt WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY order_date DESC

SELECT i.product_name, i.product_code, i.unit_price, i.qty, i.amount, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date, r.doc_type FROM order_receipt_item i INNER JOIN order_receipt r ON r.receipt_id = i.receipt_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.product_name, COALESCE(i.product_code, '-') AS product_code, SUM(i.qty) AS total_qty, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_receipt_item i INNER JOIN order_receipt r ON r.receipt_id = i.receipt_id GROUP BY i.product_name, i.product_code ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_name, p.product_code, p.unit, p.reorder_point, COALESCE(inv.qty_on_hand, 0) AS qty_on_hand, w.warehouse_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = inv.warehouse_id AND (w.warehouse_type IS NULL OR w.warehouse_type != 'DEFECT') WHERE p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY qty_on_hand ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_active = 1) AS product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_receipt WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m')) AS month_order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM order_receipt WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m')) AS month_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND COALESCE(inv.qty_on_hand,0) <= p.reorder_point) AS low_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_doc WHERE status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')) AS pending_count FROM DUAL
SELECT doc_id, title, status, requester_id, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at FROM approval_doc WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count FROM approval_doc WHERE DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT r.doc_type, i.product_name, i.qty, i.amount, r.partner_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS order_date FROM order_receipt_item i INNER JOIN order_receipt r ON r.receipt_id = i.receipt_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.dept_name, COUNT(*) AS emp_count, SUM(s.base_salary) AS total_base, SUM(s.net_pay) AS total_net FROM salary s INNER JOIN employee e ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.pay_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY e.dept_name ORDER BY total_net DESC
SELECT dept_name, COUNT(*) AS headcount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM employee GROUP BY dept_name ORDER BY headcount DESC
